authorized_scope: Read existing local docs/source; write only audits/attention_source_bridge_design_v1/review.md and metadata.json. No inference, fits, worlds, archives, reports, existing-code/doc edits, or commits.

findings.grounded_risk_state: local sensory-memory transform with correctness heads, no routing input
findings.grounded_route_state: latest-delivery-history transform with no content input
findings.grounded_after_state: task-success forecast composition, not constructed content form
findings.physical_decoder: external objective-image property readout, sensory inheritance viable
findings.legacy_candidates: categorical binding, simulated access/quality and content uncertainty; no transferred grounded qualification
findings.negative_scope: no currently qualified native strict counterpart in inspected definitions and measurements; not exhaustive latent-information or absence-of-experience claim

proposed_experiment.primary_counterpart: learned content-bound prediction of actual present internal spatial-pattern form
proposed_experiment.mechanism: post-encoder spatial-pooling-bandwidth attention operation on fixed saved sensory memory; compare predicted and actual internal transitions
proposed_experiment.primary_dissociation: identical pixels/stored maps/original logit/native risk while randomized endogenous attention changes current internal pattern
proposed_experiment.confidence_limit: same original decision coordinate does not fix all possible W-derived metacognition; hold-out alternative readouts retained
proposed_experiment.controller: separate selector/executor; no presumed experiencing locus
proposed_experiment.experience_scope: unauditable; a qualified represented-form counterpart does not automatically qualify felt/apparent quality
proposed_experiment.primary_role: narrower attention-control forward modeling and corrective action
proposed_experiment.optional_stronger_role: shared-schema discrepancy refines separate Modeler reconstruction, tested on later independent actual observations
proposed_experiment.optional_extension_limits: not full MSTC, not mandatory, ordinary predictive learning remains viable
proposed_experiment.stopping: one complete reserved development attempt; no post-output target/head or criterion replacement in that version

alternatives: engineered representation compatibility without felt experience
important_falsifiers: no pre-output semantic distinction of internal form from access/uncertainty/objective pixel statistics
no meaningful naturally executed same-V form change
form fully accounted for by W-derived decision/confidence
only Controller changes improve without Modeler reconstruction improvement in stronger extension
accurate technical-only reports or unsupported presentation wording
ordinary predictor/narrator parity limits unique attribution

exposure.primary_MSTC_check: parent relayed v5 role distinctions after its primary-paper check; this agent did not independently retrieve/verify primary paper
exposure.published_report_reference_basis: local primary-reference review; no new primary-paper retrieval by this agent

hash_receipt_scope: Hashes captured at metadata finalization; static review used cat/sed/rg and retained summaries. Whole source bytes not archived separately.

receipts.validation: review file read and metadata JSON parse/hash checked; no numerical assay executed

preservation: All existing studies, historical failures, frozen protocols and source untouched.
